name: ArchAI Standard Vastu Shastra & Engineering Rules
description: Configurable, extensible Vastu Shastra and spatial engineering rules for residential floor plans.

rules.name: Pooja Room in Ishanya (North-East)
rules.good_description: Pooja room is auspiciously situated in the North-East (Ishanya) zone, maximizing divine and spiritual cosmic energies.
rules.defect_description: Pooja room is located in the %CURRENT_SECTOR% sector. Vastu Shastra strongly recommends Ishanya (North-East) for prayer spaces.
rules.remedy: Shift the sacred altar to the North-East zone of the house, or align deities facing East/North inside the room.

rules.name: Kitchen in Agneya (South-East Fire Quadrant)
rules.good_description: Kitchen is ideally positioned in the South-East (Agneya) quadrant, aligned with the primordial Fire element (Agni Devata).
rules.defect_description: Kitchen is located in the %CURRENT_SECTOR% sector. Placing a kitchen in North-East (Water) or South-West (Earth) creates elemental conflict.
rules.remedy: Relocate cooking stove/kitchen towards South-East or North-West. Avoid placing water taps directly adjacent to cooking stoves.

rules.name: Master Bedroom in Nairutya (South-West)
rules.good_description: Master Bedroom is grounded in the South-West (Nairutya / Earth) zone, promoting stability, authority, and peaceful rest.
rules.defect_description: Master Bedroom is placed in the %CURRENT_SECTOR% sector. Locating it in North-East or Center causes restlessness and loss of domestic stability.
rules.remedy: Designate the South-West room as the primary bedroom. Ensure sleeping head orientation points towards South or East.

rules.name: Bathroom / Toilet Away from North-East & Center
rules.good_description: Toilets and bathrooms are appropriately routed away from the sacred North-East and Brahmasthan centers.
rules.defect_description: Bathroom/Toilet is located in the %CURRENT_SECTOR% sector. A toilet in North-East (Ishanya) or Center (Brahmasthan) is a severe Vastu Dosha.
rules.remedy: Relocate plumbing fixtures to North-West or West zone. Never share a common wall between a toilet and a Pooja room.

rules.name: Brahmasthan (Central 9th) Free & Unobstructed
rules.good_description: The central Brahmasthan core is open, well-balanced, and unobstructed by heavy structural loads or enclosed utility rooms.
rules.defect_description: Brahmasthan (central 1/9th of the building) is obstructed by %OBSTRUCTION_ELEMENTS%. Brahmasthan must remain open and light.
rules.remedy: Keep the central zone open as a living courtyard, hallway, or open atrium. Avoid heavy internal load-bearing columns inside Brahmasthan.

rules.name: Living Room in North, East, or North-East
rules.good_description: Living room is harmoniously oriented towards social North/East quadrants, welcoming guests with natural light and positive vibration.
rules.defect_description: Living Room is placed in %CURRENT_SECTOR%. While permissible, South/South-West quadrants are heavier and less social.
rules.remedy: Arrange seating such that the family head faces North or East during conversations.

rules.name: Structural Column Grid & Span Safety
rules.good_description: Structural column distribution provides adequate support for building spans without exceeding safe unsupported distances.
rules.defect_description: Only %COLUMN_COUNT% columns found for a %AREA_SQFT% sqft floor plate. Span distances exceed typical unsupported residential limits.
rules.remedy: Introduce intermediate columns along primary partition wall junctions to support the roof/slab span.
